backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing a virtual cosmetics shop with 50 Gorilla Tag items, user balances, inventory, purchase logic, admin fund grants (code 2807), and periodic income distribution.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two features: generating product images for all 50 cosmetic items and updating the CosmeticItem component to display those images.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend files describing the shop UI, hooks, components, styling, and image loading from /assets/generated with sparkles icon fallback.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles with OKLCH color palette variables for light and dark modes, using warm coral, peach, and rose gold tones.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title 'Virtual Cosmetics Shop' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with tab navigation between Shop and Owned Items views, user initialization on mount, header with tab buttons, footer with AdminBox and attribution, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminBox.tsx: Admin code input form in footer with subtle opacity styling that grants funds when code is submitted, includes loading state and lock icon.
frontend/src/components/BalanceDisplay.t: Card component displaying user's balance with currency icon loaded from /assets/generated/currency-icon.dim_64x64.png and gradient styling with glow effect.
frontend/src/components/CosmeticItem.tsx: Individual cosmetic item card with name, price badge, product image loaded from /assets/generated using slug mapping (with sparkles icon fallback on error), and purchase button or owned indicator.
frontend/src/components/OwnedItemsView.t: Displays a user's owned cosmetic items by filtering all items against owned item IDs, with a mapping function to convert item names to image slugs. Shows loading skeletons, error alerts, and an empty state when no items are owned.
frontend/src/components/PurchaseButton.t: A button component that handles item purchases with loading and disabled states based on user balance and purchase status. Displays different text and icons depending on affordability and processing state.
frontend/src/components/ShopInterface.ts: Main shop view that displays user balance and a grid of all available cosmetic items, fetching data from queries and passing ownership status to each item card. Includes loading skeletons and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, automatically invalidating and refetching dependent queries when the actor changes. Returns anonymous actor when not authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking. Creates an AuthClient with configurable options and persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including balance, items, owned items, purchases, user initialization, and admin functions. Handles query invalidation, error handling, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette using OKLCH color space for light and dark modes, featuring warm coral/peach tones in light mode and rose gold accents in dark mode. Includes base styles for typography and borders.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH colors, border radius variables, glow shadows, accordion animations, and container settings. Includes typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking a virtual shopping app with £100 starting balance, ~50 Gorilla Tag cosmetics at £10 each, secret admin code (2807) for £50M, and £100 income every 10 minutes. Known issues: cosmetics not loading in shop and mod panel not appearing.
